create_scannet_config: create a ScannetDatasetConfig instance to access 18-class ScanNet object type mappings and mean sizes
convert_size_to_class: convert a 3D box size to its discrete size class and residual using size2class
convert_class_to_size: reconstruct a 3D box size from a predicted size class and residual using class2size
params_to_obb: convert center, heading, and size parameters into a 7-element oriented bounding box array
rotate_aligned_boxes: rotate axis-aligned 3D bounding boxes by a given rotation matrix and return updated boxes
